moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Return
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals are set to explode across the August Bank Holiday weekend, running from August 27-30 with a massive lineup of headliners.

angles.name: Main Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds! The Bank Holiday weekend is set for a massive soundtrack with Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C. and Chase & Status leading the charge. Who are you buzzing to see? #RandL26

angles.name: Leeds Local Angle
angles.copy: Leeds Festival takes over Bramham Park from August 27-30! Get ready for a huge Bank Holiday weekend of music with some of the biggest names in rock, pop, and indie heading to Yorkshire. #LeedsFestival

angles.name: Headliner Spotlight
angles.copy: From Fontaines D.C. to Chase & Status, the Reading & Leeds lineup is stacked! Who's ready for the ultimate rock and alternative weekend starting next Thursday? #FestivalVibes

moments.title: Creamfields Celebrates 20 Years
moments.blurb: Creamfields returns to Daresbury, Cheshire from August 27-30 for its 20th anniversary, bringing over 250 electronic music artists including Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, and Disclosure.

angles.name: Dance Festival Hype
angles.copy: Creamfields is almost here! Celebrating 20 years in Daresbury with Swedish House Mafia, Calvin Harris, Disclosure and more. Who's heading to the ultimate dance music pilgrimage this Bank Holiday? #Creamfields

angles.name: Cheshire Local Angle
angles.copy: Daresbury is about to become the epicentre of electronic music! Creamfields celebrates two decades this Bank Holiday weekend with an incredible lineup. Get ready, Cheshire! #Daresbury

moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off 2026/27 Season
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially kicks off this Friday, August 21, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Season Opener Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League is back this Friday, August 21st! Arsenal vs Coventry City kicks off the 2026/27 season. Who are your picks for the title this year?

angles.name: Promoted Teams Spotlight
angles.copy: Welcome back, Coventry City, Hull City, and Ipswich Town! The new Premier League season starts Friday, and three fresh teams are ready to make their mark. Who will be the surprise package?
